address: 27, Lane 300, Section 2, Simen Road, West Central District, Tainan, Taiwan
bio: This century-old Chinese medicine shop was converted into a restaurant specialising in therapeutic food. The sixth-generation owner intentionally kept the apothecary cabinets and used some inscribed plaques as dining tables. Seven tonic soups are offered each day, all tasty and mild in herbal flavour – consult the servers about medicinal actions. Make it a complete meal by ordering a set – with noodles tossed in sesame oil, a drink and sweet soup.
